facts.text: I have past work that includes a series of black and white images taken on a Laika M6 of storms, lightning, and tornados.
I have a series called "Special Firefighting Brigade" featuring computer generated images of cute brown bears dressed as firefighters in the middle of battling forest fires.
I have a series of images of cacti in the style of "knolling" where all the items are arranged neatly in the frame.
I have a series called "Criticality" featuring dramatic computer generated images of nuclear mushroom clouds.
I have a series called "Trains" featuring old coal powered trains and bold photography.
I have a series imagining what the velociraptor looked like, feathers and all.
I have a series imagining new Harley Davidson products that don't exist, including a tricycle, an espresso maker, and a golf cart.
I have a series of street photographs of groups of young people smiling seconds after being asked to take their photo.
I have a series of computer generated images of toy soldiers in famous scenes like raising the flag on Iwo Jima.
I have a series of computer generated images of tracksuits in the style of renaissance paintings.
I have a series of computer generated images of astronauts who are all babies.
I have a series of computer generated images on bonsai trees of a wide variety of trees, many of which are not typically bonsai'd.
I have a series of computer generated images of animals wearing formal suit and tie.
I said that #2, the vintage car in the forest, turned out the best.
I said that #4 was also pretty good.
I want to iterate on the ideas that turned out well, specifically #2 and #4.
I want new art series ideas based on what turned out well and what I like.
